heading_path: ClickHouse Documentation: English Database > Database > Get started > Get started
title: Get started
content:
#### Get started

- [Get started with ClickHouse](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/index.md): New to ClickHouse? Start here — learn what ClickHouse is, explore use cases, install it, migrate your data, and experiment with sample datasets.
- [Deployment modes](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/about/deployment-modes.md): ClickHouse offers five deployment options that all use the same powerful database engine, just packaged differently to suit your specific needs.

##### Quickstarts

- [Quickstarts explorer](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/quickstarts/home.md): Explore quickstart guides to get up and running with ClickHouse

###### All use cases

heading_path: ClickHouse Documentation: English Database > Database > Get started > Get started
title: Get started
content:
- [ClickHouse Cloud quick start](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/setup/cloud.md): Quick start guide for ClickHouse Cloud
- [Obtain your Cloud connection details](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/quickstarts/obtain-your-cloud-connection-details.md): Learn how to find the hostname, port, and credentials for your ClickHouse Cloud service so you can connect from external clients, CLIs, and applications.
- [Insert data into ClickHouse Cloud using clickhouse-client](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/quickstarts/insert-data-using-clickhouse-client.md): Learn how to use clickhouse-client to insert data from local CSV and Parquet files into a ClickHouse Cloud service from the command line.
- [Creating tables in ClickHouse](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/quickstarts/creating-tables.md): Learn about Creating Tables in ClickHouse
- [Selecting ClickHouse Data](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/quickstarts/writing-queries.md): Learn about Selecting ClickHouse Data
- [Create your first MergeTree table](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/quickstarts/create-your-first-mergetree-table.md): Learn how ClickHouses primary table engine works by creating a MergeTree table, loading UK property price data, and observing how parts and merges affect storage and query performance.

###### Real-time analytics

heading_path: ClickHouse Documentation: English Database > Database > Get started > Get started
title: Get started
content:
- [Create your first materialized view](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/quickstarts/create-your-first-materialized-view.md): Learn how to use materialized views in ClickHouse to pre-compute and store query results with a different sort order, enabling fast lookups on columns not covered by your primary key.
- [Create your first projection](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/quickstarts/create-your-first-projection.md): Learn how to use projections in ClickHouse to store an additional sorted copy of your data within the same table, enabling fast lookups on columns not covered by your primary key.
- [Advanced tutorial](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/quickstarts/tutorial.md): Learn how to ingest and query data in ClickHouse using a New York City taxi example dataset.

###### Data warehousing

- [How to connect your Iceberg catalog in ClickHouse Cloud](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/quickstarts/connect-your-iceberg-catalog.md): Learn how to connect ClickHouse Cloud to connect to your Data Catalog and query Iceberg tables.
- [Updating and deleting ClickHouse data](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/quickstarts/mutations.md): Describes how to perform update and delete operations in ClickHouse

###### Observability

- [Working with the Map type in ClickHouse](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/quickstarts/working-with-the-map-type.md): Learn how to use the Map type in ClickHouse to store, query, and aggregate dynamic key-value data using OTel resource attributes as a practical example.

##### Introduction

heading_path: ClickHouse Documentation: English Database > Database > Get started > Get started
title: Get started
content:
- [What is ClickHouse?](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/about/intro.md): ClickHouse® is a column-oriented SQL database management system (DBMS) for online analytical processing (OLAP). It is available as both an open-source software and a cloud offering.
- [Why is ClickHouse so fast?](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/about/why-clickhouse-is-so-fast.md): It was designed to be fast. Query execution performance has always been a top priority during the development process, but other important characteristics like user-friendliness, scalability, and security were also considered so ClickHouse could become a real production system.
- [Distinctive Features of ClickHouse](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/about/distinctive-features.md): Understand what makes ClickHouse stand apart from other database management systems

##### Use cases

heading_path: ClickHouse Documentation: English Database > Database > Get started > Get started
title: Get started
content:
- [Use cases](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/use-cases/overview.md): Explore ClickHouse use cases including real-time analytics, observability, data warehousing, and agentic analytics
- [Real-time analytics](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/use-cases/real-time-analytics.md): Learn how to build real-time analytics applications with ClickHouse Cloud for instant insights and data-driven decision making
- [Observability](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/use-cases/observability.md): Use ClickHouse Cloud for observability, monitoring, logging, and system performance analysis in distributed applications
- [Data warehousing](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/use-cases/data-warehousing.md): Build modern data warehouse architectures by combining the flexibility of data lakes with ClickHouse Cloud's performance
- [Agentic analytics](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/use-cases/agentic-analytics.md): Learn how ClickHouse enables agentic analytics

heading_path: ClickHouse Documentation: English Database > Database > Get started > Sample datasets
title: Sample datasets
content:
#### Sample datasets

- [Tutorials and example datasets](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/index.md): Get started with ClickHouse using our tutorials and example datasets
- [ClickHouse playground](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/playground.md): The ClickHouse Playground allows people to experiment with ClickHouse by running queries instantly, without setting up their server or cluster.

##### Benchmarks

- [AMPLab Big Data Benchmark](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/amplab-benchmark.md): A benchmark dataset used for comparing the performance of data warehousing solutions.
- [Brown University Benchmark](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/brown-benchmark.md): A new analytical benchmark for machine-generated log data
- [Terabyte click logs from Criteo](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/criteo.md): A terabyte of click logs from Criteo
- [Join Order Benchmark (JOB)](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/job.md): The Join Order Benchmark (JOB) data set and queries.
- [Star Schema Benchmark (SSB, 2009)](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/star-schema.md): The Star Schema Benchmark (SSB) data set and queries
- [TPC-DS (2012)](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/tpcds.md): The TPC-DS benchmark data set and queries.
- [TPC-H (1999)](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/tpch.md): The TPC-H benchmark data set and queries.

##### Vector search & embeddings

heading_path: ClickHouse Documentation: English Database > Database > Get started > Sample datasets
title: Sample datasets
content:
- [dbpedia dataset](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/dbpedia.md): Dataset containing 1 million articles from Wikipedia and their vector embeddings
- [Hacker News vector search dataset](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/hacker-news-vector-search.md): Dataset containing 28+ million Hacker News postings & their vector embeddings
- [Laion-400M dataset](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/laion.md): Dataset containing 400 million images with English image captions
- [LAION 5B dataset](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/laion5b.md): Dataset containing 10 million vectors from the LAION 5B dataset

##### Web & social analytics

heading_path: ClickHouse Documentation: English Database > Database > Get started > Sample datasets
title: Sample datasets
content:
- [Amazon customer review](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/amazon-reviews.md): Over 150M customer reviews of Amazon products
- [Anonymized web analytics](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/anon-web-analytics-metrica.md): Dataset consisting of two tables containing anonymized web analytics data with hits and visits
- [Writing queries in ClickHouse using GitHub data](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/github.md): Dataset containing all of the commits and changes for the ClickHouse repository
- [GitHub events dataset](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/github-events.md): Dataset containing all events on GitHub from 2011 to Dec 6 2020, with a size of 3.1 billion records.
- [Hacker News dataset](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/hacker-news.md): Dataset containing 28 million rows of hacker news data.
- [Analyzing Stack Overflow data with ClickHouse](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/stackoverflow.md): Analyzing Stack Overflow data with ClickHouse
- [YouTube dataset of dislikes](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/youtube-dislikes.md): A collection of dislikes of YouTube videos.

##### Geo & location

heading_path: ClickHouse Documentation: English Database > Database > Get started > Sample datasets
title: Sample datasets
content:
- [Geo data using the cell tower dataset](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/cell-towers.md): Learn how to load OpenCelliD data into ClickHouse, connect Apache Superset to ClickHouse and build a dashboard based on data
- [Foursquare OS Places dataset](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/foursquare-os-places.md): Learn how to explore and load the Foursquare OS Places geospatial dataset with ClickHouse.
- [New York taxi data](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/nyc-taxi.md): Data for billions of taxi and for-hire vehicle (Uber, Lyft, etc.) trips originating in New York City since 2009

##### Time series & sensors

- [Environmental sensors data](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/environmental-sensors.md): Over 20 billion records of data from Sensor.Community, a contributors-driven global sensor network that creates Open Environmental Data.
- [NOAA Global Historical Climatology Network](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/noaa.md): 2.5 billion rows of climate data for the last 120 yrs
- [Taiwan historical weather datasets](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/tw-weather.md): 131 million rows of weather observation data for the last 128 yrs
- [WikiStat](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/wikistat.md): Explore the WikiStat dataset containing 0.5 trillion records.

##### Public records & open data

heading_path: ClickHouse Documentation: English Database > Database > Get started > Sample datasets
title: Sample datasets
content:
- [COVID-19 open data](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/covid19.md): COVID-19 Open-Data is a large, open-source database of COVID-19 epidemiological data and related factors like demographics, economics, and government responses
- [New York Public Library "What's on the Menu?" dataset](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/menus.md): Dataset containing 1.3 million records of historical data on the menus of hotels, restaurants and cafes with the dishes along with their prices.
- [NYPD complaint data](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/nypd-complaint-data.md): Ingest and query Tab Separated Value data in 5 steps
- [OnTime](https://clickhouse.com/docs/get-started/sample-datasets/ontime.md): Dataset containing the on-time performance of airline flights
